name: Ideon
description: Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that maps a project on an infinite canvas. Notes, files, links, tasks, kanban boards, sketches and live Git repository blocks sit side by side, are edited together in real time and can be rewound to earlier snapshots.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first visit opens the setup page that creates the super-admin. Finish it right after the install.
Links and redirects use APP_URL in /opt/ideon_data/.env. Change it behind a reverse proxy or after an IP change, add the SMTP_* values for email, then run systemctl restart ideon.
